commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Alejandro Ruiz has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+2' What a goal that is! Valentin Rosier sends a brilliant cross into the box and Diego Garcia (Leganes) scores a stunning bicycle kick goal! Wow, take a bow gentlemen. 1:0.
